utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. I could use help sorting the list and making a few calls — I’m a bit overwhelmed right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got you. Send me the list and the calls you want made, and I’ll start sorting them now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like the plan nailed down first—what exactly needs to be repaired, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair—can you confirm the exact repair list and the start time before we commit?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the repair list and a firm start time before I can commit. Once those are clear, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I haven’t been keeping up, but I’m in if you need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a huge help, Noah—thanks. I’ll grab the details and let you know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—just point me where to show up and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out too and let folks know while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block and tell anyone I see about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m in—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad you made it—there’s still a good bit to tackle. We could use hands for sorting supplies, moving furniture, and checking any repairs folks flagged.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take sorting supplies and help move furniture. Point me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10 a.m. this Saturday at the community center—just bring any tools you’re comfortable lending, and if you can, a few gloves or rags would be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds easy enough—I’ll be there at 10 with a pair of gloves and a few rags.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — we’re still on. Show up around 9:00 AM, and I’ll have the supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 9:00 AM. Do you want me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help pull folks together for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the folks on Maple and then the apartment above the laundromat—they usually show up fast when repairs are needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it—I’ll start with Maple and the apartment above the laundromat, then circle back if we need more hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help by keeping track of volunteer sign-ups and checking in on any supply needs? That would take a big load off me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can track the volunteer sign-ups and keep an eye on supply needs. I’ll check in with you if anything starts running low.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great—just tell me what we’re short on and I’ll help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick inventory and make a short list of the missing items. Then we can split up what to grab.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, you might want to go before the later crowd shows up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’ll head over soon and try to get there before it gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call, Rey—early birds are getting the best of it so far. Let me know if you spot anything they still need; I can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what items the repair drive is accepting? I want to make sure I get the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don’t have the details with me yet, but I can check the flyer and send you the date, time, and accepted items as soon as I find them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — please send them when you find the flyer. I’ll wait for the date, time, and accepted items before I help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you bring a box of screwdrivers, some zip ties, and a roll of duct tape? That should cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got it — screwdrivers, zip ties, and duct tape. I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we should spread the word about the repair drive and line up a few neighbors to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help connect the different groups and get the word out. If you want, I can start reaching out to a few neighbors and see who can volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Jules — let’s start with a few reliable folks and see who can pitch in. I’ll keep spreading the word and we can compare notes as people reply.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details, but I’m interested; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. If you can help sort donations or spread the word, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that — I’ll help sort donations and share the word around. Just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Rey—could you bring your toolbox and help me sort the donated parts?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely, I’ll grab my toolbox and head over. We can sort the parts together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive organized, Opal. Let’s make a simple list of what needs fixing and who can help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll start a clean list of the spots that need attention and note who’s available to help with each one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — once we have the list, I can group the repairs by priority and we’ll match each one with a helper.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the schedule and where we’re meeting so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the schedule and meeting spot as soon as I have the details, and I’ll make sure you’re on the list. If you want, I can also keep you posted on any updates for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot — please keep me posted once you have the schedule and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed it yet—let me check the details before we say it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—so not definite yet. Let me know once you’ve confirmed the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in—just tell me the plan and the time, and I’ll keep it simple and follow along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect—let’s keep it simple. We’re meeting at the repair drive at 10, and I’ll fill you in when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—10 works for me. I’ll be there and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still collecting tools and spare parts, and I’ve got a list going so nothing gets missed. If you hear anyone has wire, screws, or a ladder, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for wire, screws, or a ladder and pass it along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to stop by and help out; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren—if you can bring a screwdriver set, some spare screws, and work gloves, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it—I’ll grab a screwdriver set, spare screws, and work gloves and head over soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it around school pickup and drop-off. What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 9:00 AM. That should give us time to set up before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I can be there after drop-off to help set up. Just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help however I can; just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — I’m still getting the second-hand version, but I heard they need help sorting donations and maybe a few hands for pickup. If you’re up for it, I can pass along the exact time once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, please pass it along when you get it. Sorting donations or helping with pickup both sound fine to me — I can make time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo—yeah, I’m pretty sure we still need boxes, tape, and maybe a few paint brushes. I might be missing something, though.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supply list and see what we’ve already got, then I’ll make a note for boxes, tape, and paint brushes. If anything else turns up, I’ll add it too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let’s start with the loose front gate, then we can look at the leaky faucet after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll grab the tools and start on the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you handle sorting the donated tools and labeling the boxes? That would be a huge help for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and label the boxes for the repair drive. I’ll get started and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still on schedule, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — as far as I know, it’s still on schedule. I can check in with the team if you want the latest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you check and let me know if anything changed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout—people are really pitching in. If you want, I can pass along the latest on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Just let me know what still needs doing and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—last I heard they still need a few folks for sorting donations and helping load up the bigger items. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the repair drive needing most right now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mostly tools, sturdy gloves, and a few extra hands for the heavy lifting.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—I'll spread the word and see if I can round up a couple more hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries — keep it simple. Just tell me what you can take on, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort tools, label donations, or make a short list of needed parts. I just can’t do anything too time-consuming.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I was thinking late afternoon on weekdays, after pickup, and maybe a Saturday morning slot too. If that works, I can keep the rest flexible.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work well—I can pencil in weekday late afternoons after pickup and a Saturday morning option. Send me the days you’re considering, and I’ll line it up around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still gathering a few folks for the repair drive, and I’ll circle back once I’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you organizing that. Send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll help coordinate the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’m still lining up a few more neighbors, and I’ll send you the list as soon as it’s ready so we can coordinate the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Quinn, what’s the latest on the repair drive? Is there anything you still need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Mina! I’m still pulling people together—if you can help spread the word, that’d be awesome. I’ll send you the current list of supplies and volunteers right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — send me the list, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, fair — I’m still waiting on the exact timing too, but I heard we’d start at the community hall and then make the drop-off run after that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps — if you hear the time, let me know as soon as you can so I can block it off. I’ll plan to meet at the community hall unless the route changes.
